mapper.select: SELECT id, corp_id, open_kfid, cursor, enabled_at, updated_at FROM crm_wecom_kf_sync_cursor WHERE corp_id = #{corpId} AND open_kfid = #{openKfid} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crm_wecom_kf_sync_cursor (corp_id, open_kfid, cursor, enabled_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{corpId}, COALESCE(#{openKfid}, ''), #{cursor}, COALESCE(#{enabledAt}, now()), now()) ON CONFLICT (corp_id, open_kfid) DO NOTHING
